items.title: 68097_Freddie Green oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWEE] Sweets, Jack Washington. ... [INTERVIEWEE] As far as his playing was concerned, you know -- he was a section man ... Great big sound, and a very good musician.

ctx.x: and -- I mean, next you have those two tenor saxophone players. Well, Sweets was another one.
Yeah. Well, Jack Washington -- was he as much of a personality, Freddie?
